_comment: Vanzik MCP Gateway config for Cline (VS Code extension). See cline-config.md for the file path inside VS Code's globalStorage and verification steps. Source: https://docs.cline.bot/mcp/configuring-mcp-servers (verified 2026-05-05). Cline reuses Claude Desktop's mcpServers schema and adds disabled / alwaysAllow. Do NOT pass --api-key '$VANZIK_API_KEY' literally — Cline does not shell-expand $VAR in JSON args. Inject the key via the env block; the gateway reads VANZIK_API_KEY from the environment when the --api-key flag is absent. --tenant-id selects the tenant whose policy applies; keep 'local' unless you registered another tenant on the server with `vanzik tenant put`. Today the gateway calls only the open /v1/check, so a missing or literal key doesn't stop it working; set the real key anyway, since it is sent as the bearer on every call. --policy is the starter policy a root install of the one-line installer writes; after a user install use the absolute path of ~/.config/vanzik/default.yaml (no ~ expansion here).
